03_historical_cross_model.svg.caption:
Stored Phase 2C-C development evidence, 18 paired cases / six families per model. Higher recall is better.
Qwen BA 55.6%; Smol BA 44.4%. Paired descriptive difference CI: -11.1 to 27.8 percentage points.
Reanalysis of old outputs, not new replication; exact-format compliance differs and model superiority is not established.
